  "title": "when a request is made using the POST method, don't set the title of the HTML page.",
  "body": "Right now, the query is displayed in the title of the HTML page.\r\n\r\nWhen the GET method is used, the history of the browser will keep the URL anyway.\r\n\r\nThe POST method allows to hide the query : \r\n* from the server logs (the explicit rules is not to log queries)\r\n* from the browser history\r\n* something else ?\r\n\r\nWhen the POST method is used, the history of the browser won't keep the URL, but it will keep the different titles, which means the different queries.\r\n\r\nIt would make sense not to show the query in the HTML page title when the POST method is used.",

      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 1",
      "body": "Technically, it is simple : \r\nhttps://github.com/asciimoo/searx/blob/master/searx/templates/oscar/results.html#L11\r\n\r\nreplace by\r\n```\r\n {% block title %}{% if method == 'GET' %}{{ q|e }} -{% endif %}{% endblock %}\r\n```\r\n\r\nWarning : not tested, may be there is a syntax error, but that's the idea."
